plan.title: Awarded Event Report Download Without Selections

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event without searching or recreating it.
Navigate to the RFQ stage named in the case.
Open the RFQ Responses view where Download Report is available.
Assert that the Download Reports window opened.
Record the report window state before activating the download.
Activate Download Excel and record whether the application downloads a file, shows a validation message, or otherwise responds.
Assert that the report-download interaction did not leave a crash or server error.
